title: Claude Code Marketplace Manifest
description: Marketplace catalog read by Claude Code at .claude-plugin/marketplace.json, or from any marketplace.json file added by direct path or URL. Authored from the official plugin marketplace reference and the official claude-plugins-official catalog; Anthropic publishes no JSON Schema.
$comment: Provenance: authored (not upstream-vendored) 2026-09-08. Sources: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugin-marketplaces ; anthropics/claude-plugins-official/.claude-plugin/marketplace.json (291 entries). forceRemoveDeletedPlugins appears only in the community schemastore schema and in no current official doc. Entry source variants observed in the official catalog: url 153, git-subdir 85, relative path 53.

$schema.description: Ignored at load. The official catalog declares https://anthropic.com/claude-code/marketplace.schema.json, which currently returns 404.

name.description: Kebab-case marketplace identifier. Registration is per name per user; a reserved-name list applies.

description.description: Also accepted under metadata for backward compatibility.

version.description: Also accepted under metadata for backward compatibility.

pluginRoot.description: Directory under which bare source names resolve; must be a relative path inside the marketplace and is ignored for ./ sources.

allowCrossMarketplaceDependenciesOn.description: Marketplace names whose plugins may be auto-installed as dependencies. Only the root marketplace's allowlist applies; there is no transitive trust.

renames.description: Old plugin name to new name, or null when removed. Chains are followed; cycles are rejected by `claude plugin validate`.

forceRemoveDeletedPlugins.description: Community-schema field with no current official documentation; treat as unverified.

name.description: Kebab-case plugin identifier used by enabledPlugins and /plugin.

version.description: Pins the plugin. The plugin.json version wins when both are set; ignored for command sources.

strict.description: true: plugin.json is authoritative and this entry supplements it. false: this entry is the whole definition; a conflicting plugin.json fails to load.

relevance.description: Suggestion signals; only honored for admin-allowlisted marketplaces.

defaultEnabled.description: Takes precedence over the manifest value.

headers.description: HTTP headers for this entry's archive download.

headersHelper.description: Command printing header JSON; the entry must also set strict: false.

source.description: Where to fetch the plugin. When both ref and sha are set on a git source, sha is the effective pin.

anyOf.description: Relative path beginning with ./, or a bare name resolved under metadata.pluginRoot.
